description: BIN / IIN lookup (card BIN checker). Returns the card network (Visa, Mastercard, Amex and others), card type (credit, debit, prepaid), card level, issuing bank and country for the first 6 to 8 digits of a card number. Use it to identify a card or where it was issued. Never pass a full card number.

bin.description: The first 6 to 8 digits of a card number (the BIN / IIN). Digits only. Never send a full card number.

name: lookup_bin
title: BIN lookup
